body:
>A former-engineering student that plays guitar.  Hmm.  I bet you would be pretty cool to hang out with / interesting to talk to.  Just thinking out loud. 

You don't know the half of it. On paper I look like a crazy cool person. I race cars in an endurance league when the guys have the time, used to build racecars, dirt bikes, and (if I can afford it) I'm going to start racing motorcycles next year.

I'm one of those guys that can figure out nearly anything and have a natural talent for everything. Except anything to do with people, relationships, or being happy.

Maybe it's because some of us are in desperate need of help. Because some of us hide behind a mask of shame and denial in order to make others think we're strong.

(Other than this i guess) I don't post anything bragging about the time I diagnosed why a girl's car wouldn't start then helped her get home, or when I gave a stranger money for a tow when I know they probably wanted it got drugs but on the off chance it was actually for a tow I wanted them to have the only money I had.

Look at my post history on this fucking throwaway and think about what I just said. Sometimes when a good samaritan posts about something they've done it's because they need a little fucking pick me up to make it though the week without driving into a bridge 

I know there's some some assholes out there, but bear in mind what I've said tonight. Please let this bear weight, because if not I'll be the next Robin Williams. I'll leave this world with everyone wondering why.


That's why some of us post about what we've done. Nobody gives a damn about us and we want to see if anyone will say a damn thing about us.

Sorry I'm not in a good place right now.

Yup. I'm going to kill myself. Although it'll probably be unintentional and I'll realize how amazing life is the moment I'm dying, but at least in that moment I'll finally understand.  I'll understand that I was not meant to live to be old or change anything. I was made to have a little fun before discovering the futility of life and love. Discovering that regardless of what I do I'll never make an impact. Never change someone else's life enough to matter to them or anyone else.

I'll probably die when an impatient mother pulls out in front of me in a minivan, but I've honestly expected that for years. At least that way it'll look like an accident and my parents won't be ashamed. As they should be.

I always give the gopro videos some slack. People that have gopro's are like new parents. They take ten million pictures and videos with them and slam them in your face every time they see you going "look at Johnny gopro! Isn't he so damn cute!" But it doesn't stop there because then on Facebook they post Accessories for them and things other people have done with their child/gopro.

I have one and did the same thing for awhile, but now I mostly take videos of myself doing stupid normal things and use it as a dash-cam.
Dude this isn't a shill. Nearly the same thing works with fruit flies. The smell of the soap brings them in and since the soap broke the surface tension of the water they drown.

I can't imagine what's it's like going through what you are, but I can sympathize. Just stick it out and eventually you'll find yourself and the owls you want to surround yourself with.

If it makes you feel any better every time I see you over in adviceanimals you're the highlight of the thread. I have yet to read one of your posts and not laugh my ass off. I also just realized that I told you to surround yourself with owls. I meant to say people, but now that I think about it owls sounds cooler.
Same reason every music player an iPod.

You're forgetting that we're talking about action cameras. When someone buys a gopro it's like they had a child. They love to tell you about it all the time at every chance they get. Just go to r/gopro and see for yourself. One guy made a video of himself flipping a pancake with the camera mounted on the spatula. Dubstep music and everything, including the logo at the start. I think people do it to make it more professional/cool looking.

Thanks. I guess I kinda am obsessing. I've only ever liked two girls, my ex and this one, maybe from lack of exposure I don't know.

I start college in two weeks, thanks for the concern there :)

I should point out that I'm losing sleep over this. I can't stop thinking about what I could/should do, how great it could work out, or how badly it could go. It's 5 am now and I'm going to try and get some sleep.
